source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.1, data build 995, released 2026-10-16

data.summary: As [your Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase) ends, if you control an [objective marker](vsdata:core-rule/objectives) that this unit is in range of, you keep control of it until your opponent has a higher [Level of Control](vsdata:core-rule/level-of-control) over it than you as a phase ends.

detail.condition: unit within range of an objective marker you control

effect.until: opponent's Level of Control over it exceeds yours at the end of a phase
